meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

copy.tagline: 通过二维码或配对码直连 WhatsApp 频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中直接连接 WhatsApp 发送或接收消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel via QR code or pairing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to directly connect WhatsApp in your app to send or receive messages.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 WhatsApp 和你对话。它用扫码或配对码绑定一个号码。若绑的是你日常手机号,它只在你与自己的聊天里回应,不读别人消息;若用单独号码,则可作为独立联系人。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 WhatsApp、让 Claude 支持 WhatsApp,或要求接入 WhatsApp 时,这个技能开始工作。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 通道
用扫码方式绑定我的 WhatsApp
用配对码方式连接 WhatsApp

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can chat via WhatsApp. It links a number via QR or pairing code. On your own everyday number, it only replies in self-chat, ignoring others. A dedicated number makes it a separate contact.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add WhatsApp, make Claude support WhatsApp, or request WhatsApp integration, this skill starts.

say_en.text: Add a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw
Link my WhatsApp by QR scanning
Connect WhatsApp with a pairing code
